svg.aria-label: Two towers. Left, the semantic expert: an image and a task prompt are embedded by a frozen shared ViT and a text embedding, pass through L LoRA-adapted LLM blocks, and the keys and values of eight tapped layers are projected by a cache adapter into a memory M. Right, the vision-action expert: fresh camera tokens from the same frozen ViT, proprioception, learned registers and a noisy action chunk are concatenated and pass through N blocks of adaRMS-conditioned self-attention, cross-attention to M, and a feed-forward layer, then an RMSNorm and a linear layer output the flow velocity, integrated with five Euler steps into an action chunk. The adaRMS layers are conditioned on the flow step, cache staleness and delay.
svg.title: Semantic expert and vision-action expert
